title: JSON-native amateur radio interchange document
description: Proposed successor format covering all ADIF/ADX 3.1.8 fields. Uses Unicode strings, RFC 3339 dates and UTC times, decimal-degree coordinates, native numbers and booleans, arrays, structured credits, and JSON Schema custom definitions. Legacy field names remain mapped; legacy wire encodings are not retained.
$comment: Field inventory source: https://adif.org/318/ADIF_318.htm and https://adif.org.uk/318/resources . ADIF_VER identifies source compatibility, not the version of this proposed format. See README.md for conversion and validation rules.

Date.description: RFC 3339 full-date, YYYY-MM-DD. No ADIF-specific 1930 lower bound.

Time.description: RFC 3339 time in UTC, HH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z. Leap-second notation is not supported.

Latitude.description: Decimal degrees; north positive, south negative.

Longitude.description: Decimal degrees; east positive, west negative.

SecondaryAdministrativeSubdivisionListAl.description: Array of alternate subdivision codes. ADIF 3.1.8 defines only NZ_Regions; at most one entry per enumeration.

SecondarySubdivision.description: Sponsor-defined code; most county/district lists are maintained outside ADIF.

ExtensionName.description: Nonempty Unicode name. Custom fields are isolated from standard fields by their containers.

JsonSchema.description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 resource. Meta-validated here; consumers must apply it to custom values in a second validation stage.

user_defined.description: Custom field names mapped to JSON Schema resources. Replaces ADI USERDEFn and ADX USERDEF declarations.

app.description: Application schemas keyed by PROGRAMID, then FIELDNAME.
Application values keyed by PROGRAMID, then FIELDNAME. Maps ADI APP_PROGRAMID_FIELDNAME and ADX APP elements.

user_defined.description: Values keyed by custom field name; validate against header.user_defined in a second validation stage.
